description: Source code implementing NR-U packet packing and unpacking functions, including handling of various PDU types, bit encoding/decoding, and data validation for NR-U protocol data units.

classes.name: nru_packing
classes.description: Class providing methods to pack and unpack NR-U protocol data units.

methods.name: get_pdu_type
methods.description: Determines the PDU type from a byte buffer view.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks NR-U data units (DL user data and delivery status) from a byte buffer view.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Packs NR-U data units (DL user data and delivery status) into a byte buffer.
